phase3_findings.description: src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 149-158: is_introspection_query catches every Exception around sqlglot.parse_one and returns False (data query). This change makes that result decide whether a catalog DataFrame is withheld (_format.py lines 431, 436), so a non-parse error (RecursionError, an AttributeError/KeyError bug in sqlglot's dialect parser) shows a schema result and lets an introspection success clear an earlier run_sql error (isError false). The INFO log records only the exception type and calls it 'SQL did not parse'. assert_select_only in the same file catches only (ParseError, TokenError). The docstring (lines 143-145) and docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md line 73 describe a narrower catch than the code has.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 390-393: the INFO 'withheld' log line records no dialect, row count or run_sql call id, so a false positive (e.g. a pragma_ data table on SQLite) cannot be traced to its query.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 389-393: a turn whose only results are introspection results returns '(no answer)' with isError false and no client-visible sign that rows were withheld. Criterion 5 requires this output; only a server-side INFO log records it.

docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md line 106: 'The factory always emits this card' names the wrong component; build_agent only admits DEFAULT_USER_GROUP to UI_FEATURE_SHOW_TOOL_ARGUMENTS (factory.py lines 165-175), and the agent emits the card when run_sql runs.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 109-110: the _strip_leading_comments docstring says '#' is dropped 'on MySQL', but line 110 also treats '#' as a comment when dialect is None. The final pass noted the same line in prose.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 136-137 (and comment line 84): 'With no dialect, or one not listed, every engine's catalogs count' is false for a dialect name sqlglot does not register (e.g. 'postgresql'): parse_one raises via Dialect.get_or_raise, the except returns False, and no catalog counts. No production caller reaches it.

docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md line 71: 'or a dialect not listed above, every engine's schemas and prefixes count' is false for a dialect name sqlglot does not register; the parse fails and the classifier returns False.

changelog.d/307.fixed.md lines 1-8: the release note omits that a data table whose name starts with the configured engine's own catalog prefix (SQLite pragma_..., Postgres pg_...) is now hidden, where before it was shown. Nothing in the note is false.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 79-91: the dialect names sqlglot_dialect_for_url returns and the _CATALOGS_BY_DIALECT keys are kept in sync only by a comment; no shared Literal/enum or test ties them. A new engine added to the mapper but not the table would fall back to the all-engine union and hide pg_payments-style data tables again. Unreachable today.
